title: KONG Puppy Flyer, Blue

excerpts.text: Regular plastic discs may fly, but they don’t fly when it comes to puppy dental health.
Hard plastic can chip dogs’ teeth as they try to snatch it out of the air.

Unlike nylon, hard plastic, or wooden sticks, rubber doesn’t splinter and is gentle on their teeth and gums.
Plus, the KONG Puppy Flyer’s flexible rubber allows it to rebound dynamically rather than rolling away like plastic discs—just in case your pup misses the initial toss.
Let your puppy’s love of fetch take flight with a safer disc that offers healthy, fun exercise for you and your furry friend.
